## Change / 변경 내용

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. / 문제와 변경 후 동작을 설명하십시오.

## Validation / 검증

List only checks actually run and their results. / 실제 수행한 검사와 결과만 적으십시오.

## Rights and sensitive data / 권리와 민감정보

- [ ] I own or have permission to contribute this work under the project's MIT license.
- [ ] Added external materials have identified provenance and preserved notices.
- [ ] No live credentials, private transcripts, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Provider authentication flows and applicable service terms were considered.
- [ ] Korean/English documentation is updated for changed behavior.
- [ ] Commits are signed off under DCO 1.1.

각 항목을 실제로 확인한 경우에만 체크하십시오.
